decisions.rationale: The new SL-7 evidence is distinct from the previous FaultRemoved issue: the broad forced CA_backManual/CB_backManual/CP_backManual/CC_backManual/TerminateAC transitions can still enter Manual while pump_fault remains active, and Manual.enter unconditionally cleared alarm_signal.
